verdict.rationale: Hands-on reports show Google Cloud budget alerts and cost-anomaly alerts exist, but they fired hours late: one user set an €80 alert and still ended up with a €54,000+ bill. Another user found no easy hard billing cap; the only workaround was wiring a budget alert to Pub/Sub to disable billing. The pricing docs mention a prepaid option and viewable rate limits, which bound spend only indirectly. Missing for 10: a native hard spending cap, real-time budget enforcement, first-party docs describing caps or alerts for the Gemini API, and alerts that fire promptly.
